notes: Phase 0 baseline: reproduces the original hardcoded 4-batch task_100_materials.py behavior EXACTLY. Batches with a verbatim 'focus' string use it as-is; Phase 4 batches may omit 'focus' and provide 'description' instead, in which case the flagship/prohibition constraint sentence is generated from allow_cu_flagship.

batches.focus: Cu-based materials (any structural family). Assign EVERY material in this batch Disease_Intervention=direct_antibacterial AND Mechanism=microbiome_remodeling — the flagship selective-antibacterial, microbiome-remodeling Cu candidates (Cu2+/Cu+ redox cycling, pathogen-selective killing, beneficial-flora sparing, SCFA restoration)

mixed materials across varied elements (Fe, Co, Mn, Ni, Zn, Mo, and a FEW Cu). Cu-based materials are welcome but must NOT dominate this batch. Do NOT assign direct_antibacterial together with microbiome_remodeling in this batch
non-Cu comparison materials (Fe, Mn, Ce, Ni based) with diverse intervention/mechanism assignments. Do NOT assign direct_antibacterial together with microbiome_remodeling in this batch

non-Cu novel materials (Pt, Au, Ag, Zn, Mo and mixed compositions) with diverse intervention/mechanism assignments. Do NOT assign direct_antibacterial together with microbiome_remodeling in this batch
